[[File:Black 2 White 2 Mom.png|thumb|200px|Concept art from Pokémon Black 2 and White 2]]'''Mom''' (Japanese: '''おかあさん''' ''mother'') is the [[mother]] of {{ga|Nate}} or {{ga|Rosa}} in {{B2W2}}. She lives in [[Aspertia City]], and is an old friend of [[Professor Juniper]]. She is fairly knowledgeable about the various locations in Unova, and used to work as a [[Pokémon Center]] receptionist. {{color2|000|Pokémon Black and White Versions 2|Black 2 and White 2}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Mom (Black 2 and White 2)/Quotes}} ==Items given== {{itlisth|normal}} {{Itemlist|Running Shoes|Given to the player in [[Aspertia City]]|B2=yes|W2=yes}} {{itlistfoot|normal}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Whitley mother Adventures.png|thumb|160px|Whitley's mother in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] [[File:Whitley mother Team Plasma Adventures.png|thumb|120px|left|Whitley's mother as a member of Team Plasma]] ===={{MangaArc|Black & White}}==== {{adv|Whitley}}'s mother debuted in this arc. Along with her daughter, she is a former {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}. She was first seen in ''[[PS524|A Difficult Parting]]'', evacuating from a Team Plasma house after Team Plasma's defeat alongside other Team Plasma Grunts. When Whitley asked if she could take one of the [[Foongy|Pokémon]] liberated by {{adv|N}} along with her, her mother refused before [[Anthea and Concordia]] allowed it. ===={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}==== Two years later, in ''[[PS525|The Transfer Student]]'', Whitley's mother enrolled her daughter in the [[Aspertia City]] [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]]. The decision to transfer Whitley from her previous school was to cut all connections to her past as a member of Team Plasma. In ''[[PS537|Colress Machine]]'', Whitley called her mother to learn about a group of black-suited Team Plasma Grunts that stole Pokémon from their Trainers and proceeded to throw them away when defeated in battle. Whitley's mother revealed that the black-suited Grunts are part of a group of Team Plasma members who chose to reject N's ideals and instead use liberated Pokémon for their own desires. She revealed that the pendant Whitley received from Anthea and Concordia actually contained a microchip containing data on a machine capable of counteracting [[Colress Machine|a Pokémon-controlling device]] created by [[Colress]], the new leader of Team Plasma. Whitley's mother told her daughter to take the pendant to [[Rood]] or [[Gorm]]. In ''[[PS539|Frozen World]]'', it was revealed that Whitley's mother used to work at a [[Pokémon Day Care]]. She chose to join Team Plasma after taking care of many Pokémon that had been hurt by humans. ==Related articles== * [[Mother]] {{Team Plasma}} {{NPC|normal|unova=yes}} {{Project CharacterDex notice}} [[Category:Mothers]] [[Category:Female characters]] [[Category:Black 2 and White 2 characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters]] [[Category:Members of Team Plasma]] [[zh:妈妈（桧扇市）]]
